column3: {"expression": "(() => { const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length===0 && /^\\s*Menu\\s*$/.test(e.textContent)); if(!m) return 'no menu node'; let p=m.parentElement; const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<4&&p;i++){out.push(p.tagName+'.'+p.className+' | '+p.innerText.slice(0,300).replace(/\\n/g,' / ')); p=p.parentElement;} return out.join('\\n'); })()"}

{"expression": "(() => { const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('[class*=enu], [aria-label*=enu], [id*=enu], [data-testid*=enu], img[alt*=enu], a[href*=enu]')]; return els.length + '\\n' + els.slice(0,30).map(e=>e.tagName+' '+(e.className&&e.className.baseVal===undefined?e.className:'')+' '+(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||e.getAttribute('alt')||e.getAttribute('href')||'')+' | '+e.innerText.slice(0,120).replace(/\\n/g,' / ')).join('\\n'); })()"}

{"expression": "(() => { const t=document.documentElement.textContent; const re=/veg|menu|dish|entr[e\u00e9]e|\\$\\d/gi; const hits=[]; let m; while((m=re.exec(t))&&hits.length<40){hits.push(t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-60),m.index+80).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));} return t.length+'\\n'+hits.join('\\n'); })()"}

{"expression": "(() => { const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('script')].map(s=>s.textContent).join('\\n') + [...(document.documentElement.innerHTML.match(/self\\.__next_f\\.push\\(\\[1,\"[\\s\\S]*?\"\\]\\)/g)||[])].join('\\n'); const re=/\\{[^{}]*\"name\":\"[^\"]*\"[^{}]*\"price\"[^{}]*\\}/g; const out=new Set(); let m; while((m=re.exec(t))) out.add(m[0].replace(/\\\\\"/g,'\"')); return [...out].slice(0,60).join('\\n'); })()"}

{"expression": "(() => { const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('script')].map(s=>s.textContent).join('\\n'); const i=t.indexOf('Vegan Burger'); const j=t.indexOf('Vegan Nachos'); return t.length+' | '+i+' | '+t.slice(Math.max(0,j-400), j+900); })()"}

{"expression": "(() => { let t=[...document.querySelectorAll('script')].map(s=>s.textContent).join('\\n').replace(/\\\\\"/g,'\"').replace(/\"\\]\\)self\\.__next_f\\.push\\(\\[1,\"/g,''); const re=/\"name\":\"([^\"]+)\",\"price\":([\\d.]+),\"description\":\"([^\"]+)\"/g; const seen=new Map(); let m; while((m=re.exec(t))) seen.set(m[1],m[2]+' | '+m[3]); return [...seen].map(([k,v])=>k+' | '+v).join('\\n'); })()"}
